# Documentation

> Check out how to use the plugins for EspoCRM. Documentation contains detailed description of plugins prepared by dubas s.c. for EspoCRM.

dubas s.c. develops specialized plugins, integrations, and custom themes for EspoCRM. This documentation provides user guides, installation steps, configuration instructions, and technical specifications for both open-source tools and commercial extensions.

# Extensions

## Documentation for our Extensions

### Premium Extensions

The following extensions are available for purchase at [DevCRM Marketplace](https://devcrm.it/marketplace/).

- [Cal.com Integration](https://docs.dubas.pro/extensions/calcom/)
- [DAV Integration](https://docs.dubas.pro/extensions/dav/)
- [GUS Integration - Database of companies](https://docs.dubas.pro/extensions/gus/)
- [KSeF Integration - Invoices management for Polish companies](https://docs.dubas.pro/extensions/ksef/)
- [PayPal Integration](https://docs.dubas.pro/extensions/paypal/)
- [Send](https://docs.dubas.pro/extensions/send/)
- [Stripe Integration](https://docs.dubas.pro/extensions/stripe/)
- [Tawk.to Integration](https://docs.dubas.pro/extensions/tawk/)
- [Time Tracker](https://docs.dubas.pro/extensions/time-tracker/)
- [VAT/VIES Integration](https://docs.dubas.pro/extensions/vies/)
- [WooCommerce Integration](https://docs.dubas.pro/extensions/woocommerce/)
